mathematics.assertion_tested: Inspect EVERY P48 raw row: independently recompute integer cuts and all primary/frontend decoder choices; reconstruct count/Gaussian PIT, common Cref and preparation intensity/signed-eigenvector candidates, labelled assignment feasibility/log cost; verify all gain/query/time frontiers and physical source/unitary/eigen/Gram/covariance/marginal diagnostics with stdlib only. No new sampling.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer adjacency/cuts, Python stdlib float/complex-independent intensity arithmetic and math.erfc; declared numerical tolerances only
mathematics.conventions: Post-hoc audit of the one already completed run, not a preregistered discovery or independent distribution replication. Every raw row inspected, no graph filter or score oracle beyond saved adjacency.
inputs: Primary manifest plus all six immutable P48 results
Every raw row; seven primary models and five feasible baselines
Saved source basis, source ports, marks/gaps, tables/repairs and preparation-candidate metadata
non_claims: No resampling, quantum advantage, new theorem or statistical gate
No interval accuracy or joint empirical-copula certificate
Informative score counts need not equal every repeated function invocation
